name: banza-evidence-bundle
description: banza-evidence-bundle (BX1.5): assembles the technical evidence bundle a candidate operator prepares before a real BANZA CA review. It gathers the SimB pre-review, Conformidade L0, Trace and Trust & BRL reports, computes readiness (SimB PASS + L0 PASS) and SHA-256 integrity hashes IN RUST, and emits a JSON bundle. It NEVER certifies, approves, adds an operator, or issues a certificate — the bundle is technical evidence, not a certificate.
